title: BEP interview state is complete enough for governed assembly
governing_clause: interaction_contract, source_decomposition, deferral_record, question_catalog, validation_result_model, steps, output_contract
test_intent: Determine whether a captured BEP interview state can be assembled without inventing required project facts, silently dropping unresolved dependencies, omitting an applicable interview domain, or bypassing the governed interview behaviors needed to make source intake, normalization, deferral and validation reliable.

applicability.applies_when: A BEP interview is claimed complete or a project BEP draft/review package is about to be assembled from captured project state.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The interaction is exploratory and no complete BEP interview state or assembly claim is being made.

required_evidence: known project facts with source/evidence traceability
source-decomposition evidence for supplied EIR/AIR/PIR, contract material, schedules, model lists or comparable project sources where applicable
evidence that sufficiently supported source-derived targets were suppressed from the question queue unless contradictory, ambiguous, authority-insufficient or otherwise confirmation-dependent
complete deferral records carrying topic/question, required datum, reason, affected BEP section and known responder/dependency routing information
confirmation evidence for any normalization that materially changed meaning, scope, granularity, interpretation, authority implication or dependency
per-answer validation state sufficient to show that discovered conflicts, missing authority and dependencies were not postponed silently until final assembly
evidence of the bounded pre-assembly closure opportunity for unresolved project-instance data the current user could reasonably answer, without mechanically replaying unchanged formal deferrals
conflict and deviation records where applicable
validation outcomes using distinct pass/unresolved/gap/fail semantics without treating gap or unresolved as fail absent evidence of nonconformance

result_logic.pass: Every datum required for the requested BEP state is supported, explicitly unresolved after the applicable closure opportunity, formally deferred with the governed record, identified as a conflict, or recorded as a deviation candidate; applicable source decomposition and material-normalization confirmation are evidenced; all applicable interview modules are represented; and no project fact or authority has been invented to close a gap.
result_logic.fail: The interview is declared complete while an applicable required domain was skipped, a required project datum was silently defaulted or invented, a supplied requirements source was not decomposed such that downstream governed targets were silently missed, a material normalization was accepted without required confirmation, a deferral lost required record fields, unresolved/deferred/conflict/deviation state was discarded during assembly, or gap/unresolved was represented as demonstrated nonconformance without supporting evidence.
result_logic.not_applicable: No complete interview-state or BEP assembly claim is being tested.
result_logic.indeterminate: The requested BEP state, project evidence, source-decomposition evidence, module coverage, validation history, normalization confirmation or unresolved/deferred register is insufficient to determine completeness.
